html: Many particles carry bacterial products, among them lipopolysaccharide (LPS) on road and desert dust. LPS bound by CD14 and MD-2 activates TLR4, and lipoproteins activate TLR2 with TLR1 or TLR6. These receptors recruit the adaptors TIRAP and MyD88, which assemble the IRAK4 and IRAK1 kinases with a TRAF ubiquitin ligase; TAB2 and TAB3 then bring in the kinase TAK1. TAK1 starts both the MAP kinase cascades, here MKK4 and MKK7 to JNK and the AP-1 transcription factor, and the IKK complex that frees NF-κB.
